source_metadata.sampling_method: All returned records in the frozen official query, ordered by source start date, until pagination ends or declared maximum. Source availability/changes may affect coverage.
source_metadata.date_policy: Preserve exact/year/month source strings and ACTUAL/ESTIMATED types; no date imputation.
source_metadata.enrollment_policy: planned_enrollment uses only explicitly ESTIMATED enrollment; reported/current enrollment is not an original plan.
source_metadata.eligibility_feature_method: Lexical nonempty-line, Unicode-word and character counts from eligibility text; not counts of clinical conditions.
source_metadata.site_policy: Counts refer to locations/countries present in this current source projection; not planned sites or recruitment performance.
source_metadata.data_use: Public ClinicalTrials.gov registry records; cite the source and review its terms. No blanket third-party text license is asserted.
limitations: Current snapshots do not prove trial-start feature availability.
Completed-only drug-trial scope omits censored outcomes and does not represent all trials.
No patient-level data, original planned completion, treatment benefit or clinical validation is inferred.
First-registered date is not a timestamp for every current feature.
Counts are an acquisition inventory; training eligibility and temporal purging must be reported separately.

validation_partition.method: Earlier tuning / later calibration, split by whole start-date calendar-day groups near the halfway group
validation_partition.reason: Independent later validation groups reserved for calibration; no refit on tuning/calibration.

policy.historical: Exclude union of retained old raw acquisitions, projections, examples, and JSON/CSV evidence before all task fitting.
policy.duration: Exact valid ACTUAL start/completion; COMPLETED; positive duration; completion no later than each page retrieval calendar day. No cutoff tuning or outlier removal.
policy.phase: Exact valid start and known single phase, independently of completion eligibility; current phase availability at trial start remains unverified.
policy.date_groups: Fixed 60/20/20 distinct whole start-date groups; duration outcome purging then later-half calibration reservation. Phase does not purge completion outcomes.
policy.scale: Finite official query around one hundred thousand trials, not millions.
policy.provenance: Current retrospective registry snapshot, not historical or pretrial validation.
policy.related_protocols: No linked-protocol deduplication or sponsor clustering is claimed; distinct IDs can be correlated.
